title: Skeletal effects of levothyroxine for subclinical hypothyroidism in older adults: a TRUST randomized trial nested study
authors: Gonzalez Rodriguez E, Stuber M, Del Giovane C, Feller M, Collet TH, Löwe AL, et al.
journal: Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism
population: Community-dwelling adults over 65 with subclinical hypothyroidism at the Swiss TRUST sites with baseline and 1-year bone examinations; mean age 74.3 years, 45.4% women, 19.6% osteoporotic
funder: Funding statement not read: the publisher's full text and the repository accepted version returned HTTP 403 to automated access.
result: One-year change in lumbar spine bone mineral density +0.8% with levothyroxine against -0.6% with placebo (difference +1.4%, 95% CI -0.1 to 2.9); no between-group differences in trabecular bone score (-1.3%, -3.1 to 0.6), total hip density (-0.2%) or bone turnover markers (serum CTX +24.1%, -7.9 to 56.2). Results read from the PubMed abstract.
